decisionsTitle: «Planul voluntarilor»: who stands at which point of the route; and an event's raffle in the backoffice — «Avem tombolă», «Participă la tombolă» and «Prezent» on its list (amending §289 and the decision of 2026-11-15 that added «Lista pentru tombolă»)
decisionsSection:
### Part one: «Planul voluntarilor»

**The owner, 2026-11-16, with a map of Saturday's route and seven points marked on it:** «e foarte important sa avem planul de voluntari si fiecare in ce punct ramane».

**What was there.** An event's volunteers have roles — what each person does («Direcționare», «Punct de hidratare») — and the route has its points («Puncte pe traseu», §757), among them the junctions where somebody shows the way (§770). Nothing said which person stands at which point: six people given «Direcționare» were six people, and the plan lived on paper.

**Decision.** One more thing the organizers may say about a volunteer: the point of the route they stand at — one of the event's own points, or none (`event_volunteers.checkpoint_id`, migration `0204`, expand only). One point a person: the plan answers «where is Ana», and what she does there her roles already say.

**The page.** «Planul voluntarilor», per event (`/admin/events/[id]/plan-voluntari`), reached from the «Voluntari» list's toolbar: the points in the route's order — numbered as the route meets them, with the kilometre, the name and what the point is — each with its people: the name, the volunteer's number, the telephone number as a link, the roles given, «neconfirmat încă» for an offer not confirmed. Under them «Fără punct pe traseu»: everybody still to place, or whose work is not on the route (the start, the kits), which their roles say. The plan is built on the page itself — «Pune aici» under each point offers whoever stands at none, «Scoate» takes a person off — and printed from it: the paper leaves the buttons out. The «Voluntari» list says each person's point in a column «Punct», with one event chosen that has points.

**Who.** Whoever works the volunteers (`canManageVolunteers`: the Organizer and the Administrators), asserted by the page and again by the service; anybody else gets a 404. Each change is audited as every other edit of a person's boxes (`volunteer.edited`, the box and the point's id, never a name).

**What it does not do.** Nobody is told: no email leaves from the plan, and it is on no public page, no badge and in none of the volunteers' files. No role, state or number moves. A cancelled person is on no plan and is placed nowhere; they keep the point they had, in case they come back. A point taken off the route frees its people; a point moved or renamed in the editor keeps them (the editor's save keeps a point's id) — an import of the event's file that changes the points replaces them, and the plan with them.

**The person's own data.** «Toate datele unei persoane» names the point (art. 15 GDPR: a column of the row like any other).

**Not done.** Telling each volunteer their point by email; the point as a column of the volunteers' Excel and CSV; the route's map on the plan. The numbers on the plan are the route's order, so a point the club does not staff still takes a number.

### Part two: «Avem tombolă» and «Participă la tombolă»

**The owner, the same day:** «mai trebuie o bifă importantă, și coloană peste tot de „participă la tombolă" și o setare per eveniment cum ar fi „avem tombolă" dar doar în backoffice vizibil» — and, of how people come to be in it: «nu știu cum să fac cu tombola, cred că trebuie link separat de înscriere cu nr de concurs/voluntar». Asked, the owner chose: everybody who is there is in, with no sign-up of their own; the draw is made outside the site; and the volunteers' numbers stay the series they were given a day earlier (the decision of 2026-11-15 that added «Lista pentru tombolă» too).

**What was there.** «Lista pentru tombolă» (that decision of 2026-11-15): one file for one event, the confirmed runners and the confirmed volunteers who wear a number. Nothing said that an event holds a raffle, and nobody could be left out of the file.

**Decision.** Three booleans (migration `0205`, expand only).

- **«Avem tombolă»** on the event (`events.has_raffle`), a tick in the editor's «Numere de concurs», off by default. The organizers' own switch: it shows the «Tombolă» column on the event's lists and nothing else. No public page, email or count reads it — it is not among the public columns — and it is one edition's own: a series' later dates, a copy and the event's file start without it.
- **«Participă la tombolă»** on a registration (`registrations.in_raffle`) and on a volunteer (`event_volunteers.in_raffle`), **on by default**: everybody is in until an organizer takes them out. On the registrations list, with one event chosen that holds a raffle, the column «Tombolă» is a one-press tick; on the «Voluntari» list the same tick stands on each row. Each press posts the state it wants, is audited (`registration.raffle_included` / `registration.raffle_excluded`; a volunteer's as every edit of their boxes) and tells nobody.
- **The file** leaves out whoever was unticked, and has a fourth column, «Prezent»: whether the desk checked the runner in.

**Who ticks, and who sees it.** The owner, later the same day: «toată lumea poate participa la tombolă dar doar adminul și organizatorul pot bifa și vedea asta». So the tick on a registration is pressed by whoever reads the registrations — the Organizer and the Administrators (`canReadRegistrations`) — and the volunteers' by whoever works the volunteers, the same roles. This amends §289, which gave the Organizer the registrations to read and nothing on them to change: the raffle tick is the one thing the Organizer changes on a registration. It is the organizers' own raffle to run, and the tick moves nothing a registration owns. Nobody else sees the column — the two lists are those roles' alone — and nothing public says a raffle is held.

**Why «Prezent» is a column and not a condition.** The owner chose a raffle among who is there. A file that held only the people the desk checked in would be empty before the race and — at a desk that hands out numbers without pressing «Prezent» for everybody — nearly empty after it, at the very moment of the draw. So the file says who was checked in and the club filters by it. The desk checks no volunteer in, so a volunteer's cell is empty: a confirmed volunteer is in.

**A tick moves nothing else.** No state, place, number, count, kit or email, and neither the allocator nor the capacity formula reads it: a guard holds the list of files that may name the three columns (`tests/unit/registrations/raffle-never-leaves.test.ts`). It is set at any time and in any state; only a confirmed person with a number is written on the file, whatever the tick says.

**Refused.** A separate sign-up link where a person types their race or volunteer number, the owner's first thought: a public form that takes a number anybody can type needs a way to know the typist is that number's person, a new text for the privacy notice, and one more thing for a runner to do on the day — for a list the desk already has. And numbers «V1, V2…» for the volunteers, offered and chosen earlier the same day, then withdrawn by the owner once it was clear the volunteers already draw a series of their own that no runner's number can meet.

**Not done.** A line of the race's elite list (a name on a bib, nobody registered, §895) is still not in the file and is given no number by itself: a registration marked «Elită» has its race number like any other and is in. The tick on the registration's own page and in the registrations' Excel and CSV. `CLAUDE.md`'s row of staff verbs names the tick in four words — «changes only the raffle tick», of the Organizer: the file is at the size it may be, and the rule is `AGENTS.md` §15.11's.
changelogLine: - **«Planul voluntarilor»** — on the «Voluntari» list, with one event chosen, a new button opens the event's plan: its points on the route in order, and under each the volunteers who stand there, with their telephone number and roles. «Pune aici» puts somebody at a point, «Scoate» takes them off, and «Tipărește planul» prints it. The list itself shows each person's point in a column «Punct». Nobody is emailed from the plan. And an event's raffle, kept in the backoffice: tick «Avem tombolă» in the event's «Numere de concurs» and the registrations' and the volunteers' lists show a column «Tombolă», where one press takes a person out of the raffle or puts them back; «Lista pentru tombolă» leaves out whoever was taken out and says, beside each runner, whether they were checked in at the desk («Prezent»). Nothing of it shows on the site. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an event with points on its route, then a staff member who works the volunteers may put a volunteer of that event who is not cancelled at one of the event's own points, or take them off it; the press is refused for another event's point, a point no longer on the route and a cancelled person, and for any other role (FORBIDDEN, BR-REQ-060-01), with nothing written; a change is audited as `volunteer.edited` with `fields: ["checkpoint"]` and the point's id, a press that changes nothing writes nothing, and no state, role, number or email moves; a point deleted frees its people. `/admin/events/[id]/plan-voluntari` lists the points in the route's order, each with its people by name — the name, the number, the telephone number and the roles given — and under them everybody at no point, never a cancelled person; the «Voluntari» list names each person's point under «Punct» while one event with points is chosen; and «Toate datele unei persoane» names it (2026-11-16, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event with «Avem tombolă» / "We hold a raffle" ticked (`events.has_raffle`, off by default, read by no public query, carried by no series edit, copy or event file), then the registrations list with that one event chosen has a column «Tombolă» / "Raffle": a tick that posts the state it wants and puts a registration off the raffle's list or back on it (`registrations.in_raffle`, on by default), at any time and in any state, pressed by a role that reads the registrations — the Organizer and the Administrators, amending §289 for this one tick — audited as `registration.raffle_excluded` / `registration.raffle_included` with the new value alone, a press that changes nothing writing nothing, and any other role refused (FORBIDDEN, BR-REQ-060-01) with nothing written; no state, place, race number, count, kit or email moves, and neither the allocator nor the capacity formula reads the column; an event without the tick, and the list across every event, draw no such column (2026-11-16, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event with «Avem tombolă» ticked, then the «Voluntari» list with that event chosen has the same tick on each row (`event_volunteers.in_raffle`, on by default), pressed by a staff member who works the volunteers and refused to any other role with nothing written, audited as `volunteer.edited` with `fields: ["inRaffle"]`; nothing else of the person moves, and «Toate datele unei persoane» holds the value (2026-11-16, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends «Lista pentru tombolă» (the decision of 2026-11-15 that added it). Given the raffle's file of one event, then it leaves out a registration or a volunteer whose «Participă la tombolă» was unticked, and carries a fourth column «Prezent» / "Present": «Da» / «Nu» for a runner by whether the desk checked them in, empty for a volunteer; who is in it is otherwise unchanged (2026-11-16, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Planul voluntarilor»: who stands at which point of the route; «Avem tombolă», «Participă la tombolă» and «Prezent» on the raffle's list
